selection.included: All six source rows for pyruvate/DCPIP k_cat and K_M, all three MAP parameters k_on/k_off/K_D_app, and anaerobic pyruvate/FAD k_app_max and K_0.5.
selection.retained_as_source_context: The three unselected columns (both source efficiency columns and Hill coefficient) remain in each original source row, with rounding, denominator/model identity and uncertainty. They are not missing data.
selection.reason: These seven columns test unavailable analogue versus retained pyruvate responses and make the MAP K_D_app versus pyruvate K_M/K_0.5 transfer restriction executable. Source efficiencies and Hill-coefficient comparisons address different questions.
